training_method: Deterministic request-time fit from measured-depth events linked to documents marked both seeded_demo and Representative Synthetic Demo Data
training_examples: One event row per representative synthetic WellEvent with measured depth; the nearest active well supplies active-context features, preferring the same field when available.
missing_feature_policy: Missing numeric drilling or similarity values are filled with 0.0; feature order is fixed by feature_set.
historical_event_frequency_policy: Training rows count same-well events with the same mapped label and a strictly earlier event timestamp; current, same-time, and future events are excluded. Inference rows use the number of source-backed matches for that category in the current radius/depth window. Both are normalized with min(1, log1p(count) / log1p(5)).

feature_pipeline.formation_similarity: Exact formation ID = 1.0; alias overlap = 0.85; otherwise 0.0.
feature_pipeline.reservoir_similarity: Mean of available components: exact reservoir zone (0/1), exact pressure label (0/1), max(0, 1 - porosity difference in percentage points / 10), and max(0, 1 - abs(log10((active permeability + 1) / (offset permeability + 1))) / 2).
feature_pipeline.depth_proximity: max(0, 1 - absolute measured-depth difference in meters / 1000).
feature_pipeline.historical_event_frequency: min(1, log1p(strictly prior same-well mapped-label count) / log1p(5)).
feature_pipeline.pressure_indicator: typical=0.25, review_indicator=0.75, elevated=1.0; missing or unknown=0.0.
feature_pipeline.drilling_parameters: Use measured mud weight, ECD, ROP, WOB, and torque in stored units; absent values become 0.0.
feature_pipeline.scaling: StandardScaler is fit on the deterministic training matrix for each request.

evaluation_notice: Prototype model — evaluation limited by representative synthetic data.
evaluation_policy: No accuracy or holdout score is reported. The 20 usable seeded event rows have sparse target classes, including single-example classes, so an independent well-level holdout would not support a meaningful evaluation.
